document_strings: Jeffrey, we met in the summer of 1985 at "Indochine" which makes up friends for 17 yrs... can you believe it!!
During these years we have had a lot of fun watching each other grow up. But there are a few memories that particularly stand out which should make you chuckle!

First, the day Clark Schubach brought me over to your apt. and then left! After chatting for a bit you blurted out "you are a virgin right"... After recovering from embarassment I answered yes, how did you know and you said "because you talk so fast" Ha! Ha!

Then there was the day we went shopping together at Bloomingdales and you proceeded to throw me down on the floor... right smack in the middle of the shoe dept. and started tickling and kissing me all over!!
Next, there was the time I stayed at your house because my apt. was not yet ready to move into and one morning I woke up and there were white
